name: Easy Google Analytics Counter
description: Fetches aggregated page-view counts from Google Analytics (GA4 Data API) via cron and stores them on a page_views base field on nodes for use in Views.
project_description: Easy Google Analytics Counter pulls aggregated page-view counts from Google Analytics and stores them on Drupal nodes so you can build "most viewed" listings, sort and filter content by popularity, and avoid maintaining a local hit counter. The 3.x branch targets the GA4 Data API through the google/analytics-data PHP library. On install it adds a page_views integer base field to the node entity (the node_field_data table), immediately usable in Views as a field, filter and sort. A hook_cron implementation (or an externally triggered independent cron) calls a ConnectionService that authenticates to Google with a service-account JSON key, runs a runReport request against the configured GA property, maps returned page paths back to node ids via the path alias manager, and writes the counts into page_views. The project ships an optional Popular articles view as a starting point.
